skills.name: Project intake
skills.description: Turn an incomplete request into a useful brief without forcing a fixed questionnaire.

skills.name: Source understanding
skills.description: Inspect source material and preserve observations that should influence creative work.
reviewCriteria: technical facts and interpretation are separated

skills.name: Creative direction
skills.description: Develop and compare creative directions before committing production effort.
reviewCriteria: taste is expressed as usable principles

skills.name: Adaptive planning
skills.description: Build and revise a project-specific graph of work from current evidence.
reviewCriteria: each work item has a purpose

skills.name: Result review
skills.description: Review creative intent and technical integrity as distinct but connected concerns.
reviewCriteria: creative and technical findings are not conflated

skills.name: Video editing craft
skills.description: Choose cuts, transitions, audio levels and caption timing that serve the video, not just settings that make a tool call succeed.
reviewCriteria: cuts and transitions serve intent rather than default habit
added audio stays legible against the video's own sound
captions are sized and timed for the frame's orientation

skills.name: Video sequence planning
skills.description: Plan, render and revise a concrete video with exact references and honest review.
